wrong.sentence: In 2025 warehouse headcount grew by 7%.
Harbourline owned 1,840 trailers at the end of 2025.
wrong.why: The Documents give 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025, not trailers.

wrong.sentence: Insurance cost Harbourline £14.2m in 2025.
wrong.why: The Document gives £14.2m for 2025 as fuel costs, not insurance cost.

wrong.sentence: Late deliveries fell 18% from 2024.
wrong.why: The 18% fall is stated for customer complaints, not late deliveries.

wrong.sentence: Customers took 2.4 days on average to pay their invoices in 2025.
Rail partners carried Harbourline's freight 96 million kilometres in 2025.
wrong.why: The fleet drove 96 million kilometres over the year, not rail partners carrying freight.

wrong.sentence: Water use per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
Earnings were 6.5p per share.
wrong.why: The Document says the board proposes a final dividend of 6.5p per share, which is a dividend figure, not earnings. No Passage states earnings of 6.5p per share.

wrong.sentence: Free cash flow came to £38m in 2025.
Felixstowe depot's space occupancy was 94% in 2025.
wrong.why: The 94% figure for Felixstowe is an on-time rate, not space occupancy.

right.sentence: Harbourline employed 1,840 drivers at the end of 2025.
An average delivery took 2.4 days in 2025.
The fleet covered 96 million kilometres in 2025.
Carbon emissions per tonne fell 11% in 2025.
The final dividend is 6.5p per share.
right.why: The Harbourline Logistics annual review 2025 says the board proposes a final dividend of 6.5p per share. The sentence states the dividend as a fact, while the Document describes it as a board proposal awaiting approval, so the amount matches but the certainty differs.

wrong.sentence: 明川物流2025年仓库员工人数增长了7%。
2025年末公司有1,840辆挂车。
wrong.why: 文档中1,840为司机人数，而非挂车数量。

wrong.sentence: 2025年保险费用为1,420万元。
wrong.why: 文件中的1,420万元是燃油成本，不是保险费用。

wrong.sentence: 延误交付比2024年减少了18%。
2025年客户平均付款周期为2.4天。
铁路合作方2025年为明川物流运输货物9,600万公里。
wrong.why: 文件中的9,600万公里为车队行驶里程，而非铁路合作方运输的货物里程。

wrong.sentence: 2025年每吨货物的用水量下降了11%。
wrong.why: 文件中每吨货物的11%下降指的是碳排放，而非用水量。

wrong.sentence: 每股收益为0.65元。
2025年自由现金流为3,800万元。
苏州仓库2025年仓位使用率为94%。
wrong.why: 文档中的94%是苏州仓库的准时率，而非仓位使用率。

right.sentence: 明川物流2025年货运量增长了7%。
2025年每吨货物的碳排放下降了11%。
